title: Identity refinement component on dense compactifications
statement: Let ℓ be prime and k a field of positive prime characteristic different from ℓ. Let Λ be a commutative condensed ring satisfying IsLocalizingAdmissibleCoefficient ℓ Λ (the finite, integral, rational, finite-subextension, or finite-subextension condensed algebraic-closure alternatives of [sk-prop-sf-existence]). Let f : X → Y be a separated finite-type k-morphism of separated finite-type k-schemes, and let c be a scheme-theoretically dense boundary compactification of f with quasi-compact open immersion [sk-def-nagata-sketch-data]. For every K in the ordinary unbounded derived category of module objects over Λ_X [sk-def-sfb-module-objects; sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients; sk-def-sfb-derived-categories], the actual canonical refinement component ρ_{id_c}(K) of [det-sf-comp-coherence-cocycle] is the identity of Rp_* D(j_!)(K). No boundedness or localizing-membership hypothesis on K is required.

source.place: Canonical refinement maps: the refinement component has identity normalization; also det-sf-comp-coherence-refinement.proof.md, identity and composition.

proof.text: The identity clause of localizingRefinement_coherence gives e_id followed by the canonical derived identity direct-image comparison equal to the identity on j!K. Cancel the invertible identity comparison to identify e_id with its inverse. The private categorical derived unit calculation identifies the derived compositor for identity followed by p with Rp_* of the same comparison. To prove it, apply rightDerived_ext to the composite-unit normalization, use naturality of the derived unit, and reduce to the underived left unit law lowerStarComp_id_left. Deriving the equality transport agrees with transport of derived functors, by equality induction. Evaluate this natural equality on j!K and substitute the open identity equation; the two factors cancel, giving precisely the stated refinement component. The compositor is the existing refinementDerivedLowerStarComp of def-sf-comp-refinement-data; its derived-unit normalization is unfolded directly from the source-library construction, rather than obtained from the separate ringed-site composition theorem. The exact inverse-image adjunction supplies preservation of K-injectives.
